payload.name: Extract Individual Attributes from Enumerated Group Lists
payload.description: When a user assigns distinct traits to each member of a group (e.g., pets, family) in one message, during extraction.
content: During extraction, if a message assigns specific attributes to each member of an enumerated group (e.g., 'oldest is relaxed, second is playful...'), create a candidate for each member-attribute pair, not only a general summary.
Record the member identifier (e.g., oldest, youngest, named pet) and its stated attribute(s) in a durable memory (state or relationship), with the speaker as subject.
Keep the general affectionate or relational framing in a separate candidate if present, but do not let it substitute for the specific per-member facts.
Stop after one candidate per distinct member-attribute statement; do not infer attributes not explicitly stated.

solves: Construction extraction sometimes collapses a user's explicit enumeration of distinct traits for multiple group members into a single general sentiment memory, losing the individual facts needed to answer later questions. This Skill ensures each enumerated attribute pair is captured.
